thai_name: ไตติตริยะ
thai_translation: ปรัชญาเกี่ยวกับต้นกำเนิดมนุษย์
description: One of the oldest Upanishads dealing with the creation of the universe and the origin of human beings. It explains the cosmic person (Purusha) and the emergence of consciousness.

thai_name: อักษิ
thai_translation: ว่าด้วยดวงตาและความรู้แจ้ง
description: This Upanishad focuses on the eye as a symbol of perception and spiritual insight, discussing the relationship between physical sight and inner vision.

thai_name: อมฤตะบินธุ
thai_translation: หยดแห่งความเป็นนิรันดร์
description: The 'Drop of Immortality' - teaches about the nature of the mind, meditation, and the path to immortality through understanding the eternal Self.

thai_name: อมฤตะนาทะ
thai_translation: เสียงแห่งความเป็นนิรันดร์
description: Focuses on the mystical sound (nada) that leads to immortality, discussing various stages of sound and their spiritual significance.

thai_name: อันนะปูรณะ
thai_translation: เทวีแห่งอาหาร
description: Dedicated to the goddess Annapurna, who provides nourishment. Discusses the spiritual significance of food and sustenance.

thai_name: อารุนิ
thai_translation: ปรัชญาของฤๅษีอารุนิ
description: Contains the philosophical teachings of sage Aruni, focusing on the nature of reality and the Self.

thai_name: อถรรวศิขา
thai_translation: ว่าด้วยศีรษะและความรู้
description: Discusses the crown of the head as a seat of consciousness and divine knowledge, relating to the thousand-petaled lotus chakra.

thai_name: อถรรวศิรัส
thai_translation: ว่าด้วยเศียร
description: Similar to Atharvashikha, this text deals with the head region and its spiritual significance in yogic practices.

thai_name: อัตมะโพธะ
thai_translation: ความรู้แห่งอัตตา
description: Deals with self-knowledge and the awakening of consciousness to its true nature as Brahman.

thai_name: อัตมะปุราณะ
thai_translation: ตำนานแห่งอัตตา
description: Presents the story or legend of the Self, describing the journey of consciousness towards realization.

thai_name: อวธุตะ
thai_translation: นักบวชผู้หลุดพ้น
description: Describes the state and characteristics of an Avadhuta - one who has transcended all worldly attachments and social conventions.

thai_name: พหุริฉะ
thai_translation: ว่าด้วยความมั่งคั่ง
description: Discusses abundance and prosperity, both material and spiritual, and how to attain them through righteous means.

thai_name: ภัสมะชบาละ
thai_translation: เถ้าแห่งความบริสุทธิ์
description: Focuses on the sacred ash (bhasma) and its spiritual significance in purification and worship practices.

thai_name: พรหมะ
thai_translation: องค์พรหม
description: Central text discussing the nature of Brahman - the ultimate reality and absolute consciousness.

thai_name: พรหมะไกวัลยะ
thai_translation: ความหลุดพ้นแห่งพรหม
description: Teaches about liberation through the realization of Brahman and the attainment of absolute freedom.

thai_name: พรหมะรหัสยะ
thai_translation: ความลับแห่งพรหม
description: Reveals the secret teachings about Brahman and the mysteries of ultimate reality.

thai_name: พรหมะวิทยา
thai_translation: วิชาพรหม
description: The knowledge of Brahman - systematic teaching about the supreme consciousness and methods to realize it.

thai_name: พรหมะพินธุ
thai_translation: หยดพรหม
description: Describes Brahman as the eternal point from which all existence emerges and returns.

thai_name: พฤหทารัณยกะ
thai_translation: ปรัชญาแห่งป่าใหญ่
description: One of the longest and most important Upanishads, containing profound philosophical discussions about reality, self, and cosmos.

thai_name: ฉานโทคยะ
thai_translation: บทสวดของนักร้องเพลง
description: Famous for its philosophical dialogues and the teaching 'Tat tvam asi' (Thou art That), fundamental to Advaita Vedanta.
